stem: How did the plantation system influence the economic development of the United States?

options.label: F
options.text: It prevented the development of industry in the Northeast.

options.label: G
options.text: It turned the South into a major producer of the cotton used in northern mills.

options.label: H
options.text: It restricted agricultural expansion in the western territories.

options.label: J
options.text: It increased federal dependency on tariffs for revenue.
